results.name: dialog_box_show_localized
results.evidence: Calls FindResourceExA with the current language id (DAT_0069ff20), then LoadResource/LockResource/DialogBoxIndirectParamA; on failure retries with language 0x409 (English US) if different, and finally falls back to a plain DialogBoxParamA(param_1) lookup by name/ID.
results.summary: Shows a modal dialog box by resource name, trying the current UI language, then falling back to English, then to a default resource lookup.

results.name: dialog_static_hyperlink_install
results.evidence: Subclasses the parent window to 0x57e2a0 (via SetPropA "Old_Proc"/SetWindowLongA) if not already done, subclasses the control itself to FUN_0057e350 (0x57e350), adds SS_NOTIFY (0x100) to its style, saves/replaces its font with an underlined variant via CreateFontIndirectA, and marks the control with a "Static" prop.
results.summary: Converts a static text control into a clickable, underlined hyperlink-style control by subclassing it and its parent and applying an underlined font.

results.name: dialog_static_hyperlink_subclass_proc
results.evidence: Retrieves the saved original window procedure via GetPropA("Old_Proc") and forwards via CallWindowProcA (standard subclass pattern); on WM_DESTROY (2) it unsubclasses and restores the font/props saved by FUN_0057e4c0; on WM_SETCURSOR (0x20) it sets a hand-style cursor; on WM_MOUSEMOVE (0x200) it tracks mouse capture and calls InvalidateRect for hover-state redraw.
results.prototype: LRESULT __stdcall dialog_static_hyperlink_subclass_proc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
results.summary: Window-subclass procedure implementing hover/hand-cursor tracking and cleanup for a hyperlink-style static control installed by FUN_0057e4c0.
